\\
ExperienceMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
Take the nostalgic Reichenbach Falls cable car to the 120-meter-high waterfall near Meiringen and walk in the footsteps of Sherlock Holmes.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/reichenbach-falls-funicular/)

Panorama](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/panoramas/reichenbachfall/)

Place](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/faltschen-reichenbach/)

\\
RestaurantZollikofen\\
\\
Large garden terrace directly on the Aare, cosy saloon, veranda, large hall for up to 70 people and large car park.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/restaurant-schloss-reichenbach/)
- [**Alpine Bike, Stage 11/16**\\
\\
RouteMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
Easy, long ascent through Reichenbachtal up to Grosse Scheidegg at the foot of the mighty Wetterhorn cliffs. In a second loop, breathtaking descent to Grindelwald with spectacular, close-up views of the nearby glacier and snow-covered summits.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/alpine-bike-1_11/)
- [**Via Alpina, Stage 10/20**\\
\\
RouteHaslital\\
\\
After the rock barrier with the Reichenbach Falls, the trail runs along the valley floor. Hike past the nostalgic Rosenlaui Hotel and glacier gorge, enchanted by the Wetterhorn. The route then crosses beautiful moorlands over the Grosse Scheidegg to Grindelwald in the heart of the Jungfrau region.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/via-alpina-1_10/)
- [**Chalet-Hotel Schwarzwaldalp**\\
\\
AccommodationMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
This hotel enjoys a peaceful location in the Reichenbachtal. The main house and Haus Wetterhorn (80m away) offer basic double, multi-bed and family rooms furnished in a nostalgic rustic style. Bathroom and toilet located in the corridor. Sun terrace with magnificent views of the mountains. The cosy restaurant serves up predominantly regional dishes with a sophisticated flair. An ideal base for bike tours and hikes.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/chalet-hotel-schwarzwaldalp/)
- [**Meiringen-Hasliberg**\\
\\
PlaceMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
Discover Meiringen-Hasliberg in the Bernese Oberland: The Aare Gorge, Reichenbach Falls, family-friendly ski area and magnificent hiking trails await you.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/meiringen-hasliberg/)
- [**Gasthaus Zwirgi**\\
\\
RestaurantMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
Arrive at 1000m. Zwirgi Inn. Gateway to the mystical, rustic Reichenbach valley. A lighthouse for those seeking peace and quiet and a place of strength to arrive. Nature, feel-good rooms, body treatments, good food and more.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/gasthaus-zwirgi/)
- [**Restaurant Casa Tödi**\\
\\
RestaurantTrun\\
\\
The restaurant is based on the memories of when Manuel Reichenbach's parents ran Casa Tödi. His grandmother, who still cooked here, often appears in their stories.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/casa-toedi-restaurant/)
- [**Three classic passes**\\
\\
RouteMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
This loop featuring three major mountain passes starts in Meiringen, the village made famous by the Reichenbach Falls, where Sir Arthur Conan Doyle’s fictional hero Sherlock Holmes dies – or does he?](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/three-classic-passes/)
- [**Bernese Oberland private bus tour from Lucerne**\\
\\
OfferLucerneNovember 17, 2026\\
\\
Discover the picturesque Bernese Oberland and visit towns like Brienz and Grindelwald. Experience the famous Swiss waterfalls: Giessbach, Reichenbach, and Trümmelbach.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/bernese-oberland-private-bus-tour-from-lucerne/)
- [**Berner Oberland-Route, Stage 2/2**\\
\\
RouteInterlaken\\
\\
Along the Lütschine up to Grindelwald, the glacier village at the foot of the majestic Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau peaks, on over Grosse Scheidegg, past Rosenlauischlucht (gorge) and the Reichenbach Falls, where Sherlock Holmes fell to his death, to Meiringen.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/berner-oberland-route-61_02/)
- [**Sherlock Holmes Museum**\\
\\
ExperienceMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
Sherlock Holmes - The myth lives on. This is proven by the innumerable traces of Holmes in Meiringen. The Sherlock Holmes Museum is one of the highlights, besides the bronze statue and the roaring Reichenbach Falls with the fateful battle site.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/sherlock-holmes-museum/)
- [**Kiental**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
The Kien Valley in the Bernese Oberland, a holiday resort with about 210 inhabitants, is a side valley of the Kandertal. The end of the valley is part of the Jungfrau-Aletsch UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Kien Valley is within the administrative district of Reichenbach.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/kien-valley/)
- [**Adler Adelboden**\\
\\
AccommodationAdelboden\\
\\
A cosy hotel in the heart of Adelboden, just a few minutes from the mountain railways. It has 43 bright and comfortable rooms with balconies. The 32 °C panorama swimming area includes an outdoor pool, sauna, and massage. There is a crackling log fire in the hotel lobby. A ski room with boot dryers in winter and a bike room in summer. Restaurant and sun terrace with views of the mountains. In summer, the mountain railway pass is valid on all trains and public transport to Reichenbach and Kandersteg included.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/adler-adelboden-2/)
- [**Aare Route, Stage 2/7**\\
\\
RouteMeiringen-Hasliberg\\
\\
The deep Brienzersee, clear, quiet and sombre. The Thunersee, shallower, open and lively. In the middle, Interlaken, a trendy tourist centre, dominated by those icy icons, the Eiger, Mönch & Jungfrau. Picture-postcard perfect, get ready to rub your eyes!](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/aare-route-8_02/)
- [**Wohnung Bärgblick**\\
\\
AccommodationReichenbach](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/wohnung-baergblick-2/)
- [**21\. Blüemlisalp-Lauf 2027**\\
\\
EventReichenbachMay 29, 2027\\
\\
Ein Berglauf für Ambitionierte & Freizeitsportler vor einer einmaligen Kulisse.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/21-blueemlisalplauf-2027/)
